parsed.main_gap: The central refinement lemma, which supplies both bounds, is supported only by an undefined and unjustified sweep/cancellation argument.

errors.description: The construction for part (i) never rigorously defines the two arrays or proves that the proposed operation corresponds to legal splits and leaves a subproblem satisfying the induction hypotheses. The claimed bound on the final alternating imbalance therefore does not follow.
errors.quote: Repeating the operation on the uncancelled array whose parity is odd proves by induction on $s$ that its odd levels have total length at most $d$.

errors.description: The invariant asserted for part (ii) is not proved. In particular, arbitrary cuts need not respect the mental strips of height $d$, and the text does not justify why adding the next column preserves either alternative or forces an entire odd strip to remain.
errors.quote: adding the next column, whose $2^{j+1}$ strips consist of two identical copies of all preceding strips plus one parity interchange, preserves this alternative.

parsed.notes: The claiming-game reduction is correct, and the stated lemma would yield the claimed matching strategies. However, proving that lemma is the main mathematical content, and both directions currently contain major gaps rather than minor omitted details.
